component.name: Forum Font
component.summary: Forum font with classing Roman proportions

description.p: The Forum font was designed by Denis Masharov. Forum has antique, classic "Roman" proportions. It can be used to set body texts and works well in titles and headlines too. It is truly multilingual, with glyphs for Central and Eastern Europe, Baltics, Cyrillic and Asian Cyrillic communities. There is currently just a regular weight and an artificially emboldened bold.
